contracts.message: PBFTMessage contains Raw and signature only; Raw contains msg_type, data_type, view_n, epoch, and data, with protobuf defaults omitted and no key field.
contracts.signature: SHA-256 over exact Raw protobuf bytes, secp256k1 recoverable r||s||recovery_id signature, recovered TRON address must be in the epoch-selected witness list.
contracts.quorum: Configured quorum defaults to 19 and clamps to 1..committee_size; commit occurs at quorum, not quorum-1, and remains true at quorum+1.
contracts.lifecycle: PREPREPARE gates PREPARE; PREPARE quorum emits COMMIT; COMMIT quorum aggregates signatures. Votes deduplicate by recovered witness, expire under explicit bounds, and outbound messages are returned as forwarding effects.
contracts.persistence: PBFTCommitResult is stored under ASCII BLOCK<number> or SRL<epoch>. LATEST_PBFT_BLOCK_NUM is an ASCII common-store key whose big-endian i64 value only advances monotonically.
contracts.sidecar: PBFT produces forwarding and persistence effects only and has no DPoS scheduling, witness selection, fork-choice, or block-selection authority.
